name: financial-services
one_liner: A pack of ready-made AI assistants for finance jobs like building pitch decks, reconciling accounts, and prepping client meetings, that draft the work for a human to check.
buyer: An operations lead at a small private-equity fund or wealth-management shop who can't justify hiring another analyst but is drowning in reconciliations and memo drafting.
business_use_cases: A small wealth-management firm uses the Meeting Prep Agent to auto-generate a briefing pack before every client call instead of paying an analyst to compile it.
A boutique fund's back office uses the GL Reconciler to find and explain accounting breaks before month-end close, instead of a manual line-by-line review.
An independent financial consultant uses the Model Builder to spin up DCF and LBO models directly in Excel for clients much faster than building from scratch.

money_ideas.idea: Stand up a boutique 'AI-augmented back office' service for small funds, using these agents to do reconciliations and reporting at a fraction of a full-time hire's cost.
Customize one agent (e.g. Statement Auditor) for a specific fund-admin niche and sell it as a deployed Managed Agent to multiple small funds.

steal_this: Deploy the GL Reconciler for one local small-business bookkeeper this weekend and charge them monthly for 'AI-assisted books review' instead of hourly bookkeeping.
